skill.summary: Scans image folders to identify formats, analyze dominant colors and styles, and automatically classify and organize photography files.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of image-scanner:

- Scans folders and detects all image files (JPG/PNG/RAW/HEIC/TIFF, etc.)
- Analyzes main color tones (cool/warm/black and white/vivid)
- Classifies images by style (portrait/landscape/still life/architecture, etc.)
- Optionally auto-creates subfolders and moves files by category
- Generates a classification report
- Supports batch processing and multiple trigger modes
